# PeopleNexa

> PeopleNexa is an all-in-one HRMS (Human Resource Management System) for Indian
> businesses — attendance, leaves, payroll, field tracking and more, in one
> workspace. Free 30-day trial, no credit card required.

## Key facts

- Product type: HRMS / attendance / payroll SaaS, built for Indian SMEs.
- Attendance: geofenced clock-in/out from a mobile PWA, selfie check-ins, shift rosters, night shifts, weekly schedules, auto punch-out.
- Leaves: leave types, auto accrual balances, half-days, approvals, encashment on exit.
- Payroll: PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS (old & new regime) and Labour Welfare Fund calculations; bank CSV for bulk payments; Tally export; Form 16, Form 24Q and PF ECR draft exports.
- Field workforce: journey tracking with route replay, GPS check-ins at stops, expense claims.
- Also included: asset tracking, loans & advances, performance reviews, helpdesk, org feed, policies, documents, onboarding & exit management, webhooks, biometric device sync.
- Ask AI: natural-language answers over the workspace's attendance, payroll and leave data.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil.
- Privacy: data hosted in India; location recorded only while clocked in or on an approved journey.
- Pricing: per-seat per-month plans (Trial free, Starter, Growth, Pro, Enterprise), billed monthly or annually. See https://peoplenexa.in/#pricing.
